Bidders HighwayMay 12, 2026 11:15

Bidders Highway takes the auction to the audience

For us at Bidders Highway, Bimmers of Sweden is an obvious place to be. This is where the passion is. Buyers, sellers, collectors, builders and dreamers meet here – exactly the people who make enthusiast vehicles so alive. 

During the weekend, we will be showcasing selected cars and will be on site to talk about auctions, sales and the market for enthusiast vehicles. But above all, we will bring the auction feeling directly to Mantorp Park through live auctions on site. 

This means that visitors get to experience the bidding up close, feel the pulse in real time and see how a car auction can actually become part of the event experience.

One of Europe's largest BMW events 

Bimmers of Sweden was founded in August 2010 with a clear purpose: to bring together everyone who drives a BMW, regardless of model, year or style. From a small gathering, the event has grown into Sweden's largest brand event and one of the largest BMW gatherings in Europe. 

At Mantorp Park, the area is filled with everything from classic M cars and well-built enthusiast cars to modern performance machines, track cars, drifting builds and well-polished everyday favorites. Here, the car show itself is part of the experience - every BMW that rolls in contributes to the whole. 

The event offers track driving, drifting, BOS Burnout, an exhibition, a family-friendly atmosphere and often the opportunity to ride with racing drivers. In short: two days where BMW culture can really spread.

Do you have a BMW that deserves the right audience?

Bimmers of Sweden är inte bara en träff för dem som vill titta, köra eller visa upp sin bil. Det är också en plats där rätt bil kan möta rätt publik. För dig som funderar på att sälja en BMW – oavsett om det handlar om en M-modell, en klassiker, en unik spec, ett välbyggt projekt eller en riktigt fin originalbil – är det här ett perfekt tillfälle att prata med oss. 

Hos Bidders Highway handlar det inte bara om att lägga ut en bil till försäljning. Det handlar om att presentera bilen på rätt sätt, för rätt målgrupp och i ett sammanhang där entusiasmen redan finns.

See you at Mantorp Park 

Bidders Highway will be at Bimmers of Sweden on May 22–23. Come by, take a look at the cars, talk about the auction, follow the live bidding and experience one of Europe's largest BMW events with us. 

Whether you drive a BMW, dream of a BMW or are thinking about selling a BMW – we'll see you at Mantorp Park. 

 //The Bidders Highway team
